body:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for feature_flag=exp_prompt_route -> routing ~10% traffic to new endpoint `new-prompt-router-ep-1` (canary id c-88). kickoff: 2034567890. runbook: https://internal.redwood.io/runbooks/exp-route

maria: seeing a jump in 5xx for requests routed to the new endpoint — about 12-15% error rate in the canary slice. latency also +300ms p95. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/routers/canary

kevin: paging oncall -> @sre-rotation (you're oncall). please ack.

sre-rotation: ack, looking now. what's the impact surface? any customer-visible failures?

maria: mostly 502/504 from the prompt bridge. stack shows upstream worker resets. snippet:```
2026-03-14T16:31:02Z ERROR router: upstream reset by peer for request id=abc123 route=new-router
java.lang.IllegalStateException: KV cache header missing
 at com.redwood.router.PromptHandler.handle(PromptHandler.java:278)
```

dinesh: that IllegalStateException rings a bell — new routing code expects a `X-KV-Cache` header to be set by the preprocessor. if it's absent workers bail. I think the canary config didn't include the preproc sidecar.

sophie: can we flip the flag quickly? we have two options: UI toggle (Console -> Feature Flags -> exp_prompt_route) or CLI `ffctl`. UI might be slower.

sre-rotation: initiating emergency snuff (kill-switch) for the experiment. running: `ffctl set exp_prompt_route=false --scope=canary --actor=sre-rotation`

ops-bot: Feature flag update submitted: `exp_prompt_route=false` by `sre-rotation`. Target scopes: canary (10%). Propagating changes to router fleet.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic is reverting to stable route as ff propagation completes. Observability will reflect within ~30s.

maria: errors dropping — canary 5xx now at 1.2% (baseline). p95 latency back to normal.

kevin: good catch. any customers impacted? severity?

sophie: quick triage: 12 distinct orgs saw degraded responses during the ~4m window. No data corruption, just transient failures and retries. Support notified: https://tickets.redwood.io/INC-4219

dinesh: root-cause note for follow-up: router assumed preproc attaches `X-KV-Cache` when routing to new endpoint. Canary had new router but older preproc image due to a config drift in the canary manifest. I'll make a safety check in the router to fallback if header missing.

sre-rotation: handing off for postmortem and hotfix — @dinesh you're taking incident owner for next 48h? I'll go offcall. quick notes: logs saved -> s3://incidents/2034567890/logs, repro steps in the runbook, monitoring alerts muted for now.

dinesh: taking it. I'll open a hotfix PR to add header validation + safe fallback and add a canary manifest lint to the CI. planning controlled re-roll after tests.

sophie: I'll create the postmortem doc and link the followup checklist. also adding a short howto for `ffctl` emergency flips to devex runbook.

kevin: thanks all. closing the immediate fire. please add timeline + blame-free RCA items to the postmortem. :thumbsup:

sre-rotation: thanks team — handoff complete, going offcall.

ops-bot: Incident mitigation completed. Status: stabilized. Tags: feature-flag, canary, routing, emergency-ff-toggle.

deploy-bot: Canary slice traffic fully back to stable route.

maria: verified end-to-end. closing thread unless new regressions show up.

sophie: created postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood.io/postmortems/2034567890-exp-route-ff-snuff (will populate root cause + action items).

dinesh: PR opened (#4128) to add header fallback. ETA for canary re-roll: after CI and integration test (~2 hours).

kevin: noted — support to follow up with affected customers. I'll coordinate comms.

maria: thanks everyone.

sre-rotation: (offcall)
